prompt:
I need you to take charge of our Q3 fulfillment readiness initiative. Here is the situation:

1. There is already an open investigation (TASK-001) that one of the WMS developers has been working on — the inbound scan failure spike. That work has now hit a wall: the hardware vendor hasn't responded to our last two tickets, so the developer can't make progress. Please reflect this reality in the tracking system: mark that task as stuck, record the dependency on the vendor, note what progress has been made so far, and attach a brief status summary as a deliverable.

2. We also need to kick off two new workstreams for Q3 peak preparation:
   - Someone on the operations side needs to own a capacity gap analysis for Warehouses A and B, looking at the October–December volume projections versus current throughput limits.
   - Someone on the engineering side needs to own the WMS outbound routing reliability work, given the sorter downtime incidents we've been seeing.

Please delegate those two workstreams to appropriate people on the team and make sure the assignments, scope, and success criteria are crystal clear in whatever tracking system we use.

I'm trusting you to figure out who the right owners are — check the org structure first before assigning anything.
